pages.text: The $(item)angler's post$(): made with a fishing rod. Fence in water, at least $(thing)4$() squares of it.

pages.title: The Catch
pages.text: The hand fishes from the top of the post and plants sugar cane on the banks. Use the post to see everything it can bring up, and turn off what I do not want. What it throws back costs the cast.$(br2)Sneak and use the post for the map of the banks.
$(item)Bait$() in the stock, one a cast. A fifth quicker, and no more boots.
$(item)Fine bait$(). Quicker again, and now and then treasure.
$(item)Rift bait$(). The cast takes less than half the time, and nearly one in five is treasure.
